title: Execute frozen-source validation and security gates
description:
The candidate-tag caller executes the already-landed normal, security, workflow, and MSRV definitions on the freeze SHA before any candidate producer starts.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Local reusable normal CI and blocking security workflows run with identity preflight and pass Rust/web/MCP suites, repository validation, cargo audit -D warnings, both npm production audits, and exact-MSRV build/test at github.sha equal to the freeze SHA.
- [hard] REQ-02: The tested recency command records declared/stable versions and policy digest for the freeze SHA; failure, workflow/checkout mismatch, or any attempted source modification prevents all producer jobs.
- [hard] REQ-03: Evidence contains run IDs/workflow SHAs, while no archive, release tag, npm publish, or public identity is created by this leaf.

## Notes

Blast radius: execution evidence from reusable validation/security/MSRV workflows only; definitions remain unchanged.
